I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making it a perfect place to relax after a long day. The staff provided excellent service — they were polite, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile
negative_snippets: The service was good and the staff was polite and cooperative. However, the room shown online was very different from what we actually received. The pictures showed a bigger and more spacious room with a proper washroom, but in reality the room was quite small. The washroom was not clean and basic amenities were not properly provided. Also, the hotel is not located on the main road as advertised. Overall, the stay did not fully match the expectations set online.

I recently booked this hotel based on the photos shown online, which appeared clean and well-maintained. However, the actual condition was completely different and very disappointing.
The rooms were not clean, plaster was coming off the walls, and the bathroom was in extremely poor condition. There were insects moving around in the bathroom, which was highly unacceptable. Overall hygiene standards were very poor.
The property does not match the pictures advertised online. I am completely dissatisfied with my stay and would not recommend this hotel unless significant improvements are made.

IT IS A SCAM. The rooms are not as shown in the pictures online.
